release_notes:
- Full-text screening: new "AI review all" button reviews every paper with a PDF in one go. Choose Fast (results in minutes) or Economy (half the AI ops, results in 2-10 minutes). The AI only recommends: you then apply the Include and Exclude recommendations above the confidence you choose, and "uncertain" is never applied.
- Full-text screening: every study you include is now added automatically to an "Included - Final" library, with its PDF, and removed again if you change the decision. PRISMA, Risk of Bias, data extraction and the project timeline use that library. A "Rebuild" link builds it from the decisions you made before this version.
- Full-text screening: each paper in the list shows the AI recommendation already saved for it.
- Trial registry: "Save & Link to RoB D5" now really saves the comparison, even if you did not press Compare first. The comparison appears in Risk of Bias (RoB 2) for that study, including its copy in "Included - Final", above the answers table and in Domain 5. The RoB 2 AI pre-fill also takes it into account for Domain 5.
- AI Economy mode now works when you use Nexus AI without your own API key. Before, AI screening and the RoB batch pre-fill always ran at full price, and a batch could look stuck forever.
- Library lists no longer stay frozen: GRADE, Journal analysis, Data extraction, CASP/JBI, Claim-to-Citation, Integrity checker, Research assistant, Evidence gap map, Power and Full-text screening now show libraries you created after opening them.
